import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
import math

def heuristic(locs, current_node, mask, visited, step_norm, first_node):
    m = mask.bool()
    B = m.shape[0]
    cur = locs.gather(1, current_node.view(B, 1, 1).expand(B, 1, 2)).squeeze(1)
    d_ci = (locs - cur.unsqueeze(1)).norm(dim=-1)
    z = -d_ci
    return z.masked_fill(~m, -1e9)

import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
import math

def _mnorm(x, m):
    inf = torch.full_like(x, float("inf"))
    lo = torch.where(m, x, inf).min(dim=-1, keepdim=True).values
    hi = torch.where(m, x, -inf).max(dim=-1, keepdim=True).values
    lo = torch.nan_to_num(lo, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)
    hi = torch.nan_to_num(hi, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)
    out = (x - lo) / (hi - lo).clamp_min(1e-8)
    out = torch.nan_to_num(out, nan=0.0, posinf=1.0, neginf=0.0)
    return out.clamp(0.0, 1.0) * m.to(x.dtype)

def heuristic(locs, current_node, mask, visited, step_norm, first_node):
    m = mask.bool()
    B = m.shape[0]
    cur = locs.gather(1, current_node.view(B, 1, 1).expand(B, 1, 2)).squeeze(1)
    d_ci = (locs - cur.unsqueeze(1)).norm(dim=-1)
    w = m.to(locs.dtype)
    cnt = w.sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True).clamp_min(1.0)
    mu = (locs * w.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(dim=1) / cnt
    r = (locs - mu.unsqueeze(1)).norm(dim=-1)
    p = step_norm.view(B, 1).clamp(0.0, 1.0)
    z = (1.0 - p) * _mnorm(r, m) + p * _mnorm(-d_ci, m)
    return z.masked_fill(~m, -1e9)

def heuristic(locs, current_node, mask, visited, step_norm, first_node):
    m = mask.bool()
    B = m.shape[0]
    cur = locs.gather(1, current_node.view(B, 1, 1).expand(B, 1, 2)).squeeze(1)
    w = m.to(locs.dtype)
    cnt = w.sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True).clamp_min(1.0)
    mu = (locs * w.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(dim=1) / cnt
    vc = cur - mu
    vi = locs - mu.unsqueeze(1)
    ang_c = torch.atan2(vc[:, 1], vc[:, 0]).unsqueeze(1)
    ang_i = torch.atan2(vi[..., 1], vi[..., 0])
    z = -torch.remainder(ang_c - ang_i, 2.0 * math.pi)
    return z.masked_fill(~m, -1e9)

    B = m.shape[0]

    st = locs.gather(1, first_node.view(B, 1, 1).expand(B, 1, 2)).squeeze(1)
    d_ci = (locs - cur.unsqueeze(1)).norm(dim=-1)

def _mnorm(x, m):
    inf = torch.full_like(x, float("inf"))
    lo = torch.where(m, x, inf).min(dim=-1, keepdim=True).values
    hi = torch.where(m, x, -inf).max(dim=-1, keepdim=True).values
    lo = torch.nan_to_num(lo, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)

def heuristic(locs, current_node, mask, visited, step_norm, first_node):
    m = mask.bool()
    B = m.shape[0]
    cur = locs.gather(1, current_node.view(B, 1, 1).expand(B, 1, 2)).squeeze(1)
    st = locs.gather(1, first_node.view(B, 1, 1).expand(B, 1, 2)).squeeze(1)
